continuity_scope: Bloodborne base game at its North American PlayStation 4 release boundary (24 March 2015), English-language PlayStation product and launch witnesses. The Old Hunters is excluded as a later DLC story expansion, as are Game of the Year/Complete bundles, patch-specific systems, other regions/localizations, demos, and all other FromSoftware/Souls continuities.
work_or_witnesses: PlayStation: Bloodborne official US product page
PlayStation.Blog: Bloodborne arrives exclusively on PS4 this week – watch the launch video
PlayStation.Blog: Bloodborne expansion The Old Hunters launches on 24th November
PlayStation.Blog: Bloodborne Game of the Year Edition launches
coverage_rule: Zero-character evidence-constrained base-game pass. The selected official product and launch pages provide the base release, Yharnam, scourge-of-the-beast premise, player-facing action/chalice/online systems, and later-DLC boundary, but no reproducible direct in-game dialogue or item-description locators and no individual named NPC/boss profiles. The player Hunter is excluded as an avatar role. No fan source is used to manufacture a cast.
omissions: The player-created Hunter, all origin/class, build, blood/insight values, Chalice progression, choices, co-op/invasions, deaths, and endings.

All named NPCs, bosses, hunters, Great Ones, beasts, factions, and other dramatic individuals because no selected first-party witness provides an individual claim-level profile or direct in-game dialogue/item-description locator.
Origins/classes, Great Ones as a category, factions, items, weapons, places, insight, blood, Chalice systems, online systems, diseases, and mechanics as character nodes.

The Old Hunters, Game of the Year/Complete bundles, DLC NPCs/stories/items, patch 1.07 and its post-launch features, regional/localized editions, adaptations, other Souls games, fan/community/wiki material, guides, walkthroughs, lore videos, data-mines, dialogue/item-description transcriptions, and secondary character databases.
uncertainties: The selected official materials are high-level product/launch witnesses. Direct in-game dialogue and item descriptions, which are necessary for detailed Bloodborne character claims and often invite interpretation, were inaccessible in reviewed first-party sources. The pass remains terms-only.

The official product page's illness/scourge wording is a premise, not a detailed medical, metaphysical, factional, or character-by-character account. No interpretation of blood, insight, Great Ones, or endings is asserted.

The US product page is current storefront material and lists a Complete Edition Bundle, while this audit selects the original base-release boundary. The Old Hunters is separately documented as later DLC and is not folded into the pass.
English wording was reviewed. Other localization texts may differ; no translation-equivalence claim is made.
Chalice dungeons can be procedurally generated and shared; online play may change. Multiplayer/co-op outcomes and player narrative choices are non-universal.
evidence_basis: First-party PlayStation product and PlayStation.Blog launch/edition pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community guide, review, walkthrough, item-transcription archive, lore video, mod, data mine, or secondary source is used as canonical evidence.
